set.subject: reasoning
set.title: Month-based puzzle
set.stimulus:
Eight persons — Asha, Chetan, Joseph, Meera, Omkar, Sanjay, Usha and Yamini — were born in eight different months of the same year, from January to December, but not necessarily in the same order. No two persons were born in the same month, so four months have no birthday.

1. Less than three persons were born between Meera and Sanjay.
2. Only one person was born between Meera and Yamini.
3. As many persons were born before Chetan as after Omkar.
4. Only three persons were born between Meera and Omkar.
5. No one was born in the month immediately after the month in which Meera was born.
6. Omkar was born four months after Sanjay.
7. Neither Omkar nor Joseph was born in a month that has 30 days.
8. Less than six persons were born before Omkar.
9. More than three persons were born between Asha and Omkar.

Case Meera in March: every sub-case breaks clue 8 — rejected.
Case Meera in April: every sub-case breaks clues 2 and 4 — rejected.
Case Meera in May: clue 5 cannot be satisfied — rejected.

Case Asha in January survives.
Now Chetan can be in April or May (clues 3 and 5) — make 2 cases.
Case Chetan in May: clue 2 cannot be satisfied — rejected.
Case Chetan in April survives.
Continuing the same way, the remaining clues fix everyone.
Final arrangement: January – Asha, February – Meera, March – —, April – Chetan, May – Yamini, June – Sanjay, July – —, August – —, September – —, October – Omkar, November – Usha, December – Joseph.
From the final arrangement, January → **Asha**.

8. As many persons were born before the one who likes Grey as after T.
9. As many persons were born before the one who likes Pink as after the one who likes Grey.
10. Only five persons were born between S and the one who likes Red.
11. The one who likes Grey and V were born in different months.
12. W likes Violet.

Eight persons — P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W — were born in eight different months of the same year, from January to December, but not necessarily in the same order. No two persons were born in the same month, so four months have no birthday.

1. Only six persons were born before R.
2. U was born four months after P.
3. T was not born in January.
4. S was born two months before P.
5. More than two persons were born between Q and V.
6. S was born three months after Q.
7. More than six persons were born after T.
8. More than one person was born between Q and W.
